# Feeds

> Self-updating Atom/RSS feed directory: 55 feeds for sites that don't offer a usable native feed, regenerated every 2 hours.

## Resources

- [All feeds (OPML)](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/subscriptions.opml): One-shot import of every published feed
- [Feed directory (sitemap)](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of every feed URL
- [Live reader](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/reader/): Browser-based feed reader
- [Source & how it works](https://github.com/trvny/feeds)

## Feeds

- [Jbzd.com.pl](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_jbzd.xml): Najnowsze obrazki, memy i humor z jbzd.com.pl
- [4chan](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_4chan.xml): Newest threads from selected worksafe 4chan boards (news, g, o, tv, v, mu, vip) via the read-only JSON API, plus the official 4chan blog. Board posts are user-generated and unmoderated; each title is prefixed with its board.
- [9GAG](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_9gag.xml): Hot posts from 9gag.com (no native feed; parsed from the page's window._config JSON). NSFW posts are tagged [NSFW].
- [Memedroid](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_memedroid.xml): Trending memes from memedroid.com (no native feed; scraped from the server-rendered homepage).
- [Wykop](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_wykop.xml): Znaleziska z Wykopaliska
- [Daily Digest](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_daily_digest.xml): Quote, fact, life hack, fortune cookie, joke, headlines, and history of the day, plus Polish public-holiday reminders
- [Daily Quote](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_daily_quote.xml): One quote a day, with a Wikiquote link to the author when one exists
- [Quotes, Sayings and Jokes of the Day](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_theysaidso.xml): Daily one-liners: quotes across categories from They Said So, The Quotations Page, Quote for the Day and Quotes4all, sayings from Sayings.net, jokes from Jokes4all, plus a daily Bible verse from They Said So with an official Bible Gateway Atom fallback.
- [Word of the Day](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_wotd.xml): Combined daily-word feed: Merriam-Webster, Dictionary.com, A.Word.A.Day, The Free Dictionary, Wiktionary, Urban Dictionary, and the Collins language blog.
- [Unsplash](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_unsplash.xml): Combined Unsplash feed: blog, status, API changelog, and (with an UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY) fresh wallpaper photos.
- [DaTime](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_datime.xml): Time zones, calendars, astronomy and public holidays — timeanddate, Office Holidays, Holidays and Observances, Web-Holidays.
- [Wikipedia (PL)](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_wikipedia_pl.xml): Combined Polish Wikimedia feed: the Wikimedia Polska chapter blog, the Diff (PL) blog, pl.wikipedia featured content (featured article, Did you know, On this day), and the Polish Wikimedia Commons picture and media of the day.
- [Beatport Top 100](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_beatport_top100.xml): Tracks as they enter the Beatport Top 100 chart
- [RA: Resident Advisor Magazine](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_ra.xml): News, features, reviews and podcasts from RA
- [foobar2000](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_foobar2000.xml): News and change logs from foobar2000.org (Windows, Android, Encoder Pack)
- [Audio.com.pl](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_audio.xml): Polski portal hi-fi, hi-end i kina domowego: aktualności sprzętowe i branżowe, recenzje płyt i newsy muzyczne, vademecum, oraz testy sprzętu z sekcji /testy.
- [Reuters](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_reuters.xml): Recent Reuters articles, aggregated via Google News
- [Gov.pl](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_govpl_news.xml): Wiadomosci i komunikaty z gov.pl -- KPRM, Cyfryzacja, Zdrowie, MON, MSZ, RCB, Profil Zaufany, Baza wiedzy, UOKiK, PARP -- oraz Prezydent RP, w jednym feedzie.
- [US.gov](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_usgov.xml): Combined U.S. federal government feed: NSA, Department of War (Featured Stories, News, Advisories, News Releases), Space Force, FBI, NOAA, the USAGov and GSA blogs, GSA news releases, and U.S. Army news.
- [Europa](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_europa.xml): Instytucje europejskie: Parlament Europejski (przez proxy Google News, bo własne kanały RSS są za AWS WAF), press corner Komisji Europejskiej po polsku i angielsku, oraz komunikaty prasowe Europejskiego Banku Centralnego. Dodatkowo kanały news i priorities Unii, komunikaty Rady UE, agencje (Europol, EUSPA, Interoperable Europe) oraz niezależny komentarz o sprawach unijnych (ECFR, European Law Blog, UNIO, EUbusiness). Źródła instytucjonalne mają dodatkowy tag 'official'.
- [TVP](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_tvp.xml): Combined Telewizja Polska feed: TVP Info, TVP Sport, and the www.tvp.pl portal sections (Informacje, Rozrywka, Kultura, Moto).
- [PAP](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_pap.xml): Combined PAP network feed: Mediaroom, Nauka w Polsce, Zdrowie, Serwis Samorzadowy, Biznes, EuroPAP News, and Dzieje.pl.
- [Geopolitics](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_geopolitics.xml): Combined think-tank feed: ISW, RUSI, CSIS, and the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace.
- [Dwutygodnik](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_dwutygodnik.xml): Teksty magazynu kulturalnego Dwutygodnik.
- [IMGW](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_imgw.xml): Obserwacje synoptyczne, stany wód, telemetria oraz ostrzeżenia meteo i hydro z danepubliczne.imgw.pl
- [PR3 Trójka](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_trojka.xml): Program Trzeci Polskiego Radia
- [PR4 Czwórka](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_czworka.xml): Czwarty program Polskiego Radia
- [Lexus Newsroom](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_lexus_newsroom.xml): Lexus news from the USA, Europe, Poland, and the global Discover Lexus stories, in one feed.
- [Toyota Global](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_toyota_global.xml): Toyota news from the USA, Europe, the global newsroom, Toyota Connected, and Toyota Research Institute, in one feed.
- [AI-bridge](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_aibridge.xml): Combined AI feed: Thinking Machines, Ollama, Mistral, Interconnected, AI Clock, Stability AI, Promptowy, Maistry, Karpathy (bearblog + old blog), Transformer, MiniMax News, Perplexity (blog/changelog/research/API changelog), The Batch / DeepLearning.AI, and Groq (blog/newsroom/changelog).
- [Anthropic](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_anthropic.xml): Anthropic Newsroom, Research, Engineering, Red, and Alignment Science posts in one feed.
- [Claude](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_claude.xml): Claude product updates: the Claude blog, Claude Code (what's-new and changelog), Claude Apps release notes, Claude Platform release notes and system prompts, and the Claude status incident history.
- [OpenAI](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_openai.xml): OpenAI product updates: News (incl. Research), Engineering, Release notes, Developers, and the Codex / Apps SDK / API changelogs.
- [xAI](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_xai.xml): xAI product updates: News, the Grok Build changelog, and the xAI API release notes.
- [SaaS vendors](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_saas.xml): Combined updates from HashiCorp / HCP (blog + changelog), Bitly (blog + press + MCP changelog), Common Ninja, Vercel (blog + changelog + SDK docs), Apify, Zapier, Fastly, Postman (blog + press), Exa (blog + changelog), Home Assistant, Upstash (blog + Workflow changelog), Xweather (blog + API + MCP changelogs), Cursor (blog + changelog), NeuralTrust, Abnormal (blog + newsroom), Character.AI, Astral Codex Ten, and Behance (blog).
- [Cloudflare](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_cloudflare.xml): Combined Cloudflare feed: the Cloudflare Blog, the developer Changelog, Community top topics, Status incidents, and Cloudflare Research publications.
- [Microsoft Updates](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_microsoft_updates.xml): Windows 11/10 update histories, the Windows message center, Office Current Channel, Outlook (new/Mobile), Office Deployment Tool, and Microsoft 365 Copilot release notes.
- [Google Blogs](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_google.xml): Combined feed of Google's official blogs (The Keyword, Developers, Android, Chrome, Research, DeepMind, Cloud, and more)
- [YouTube Blog](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_youtube.xml): Combined feed of the official YouTube Blog (News & Events, Creator & Artist Stories, Inside YouTube) and YouTube Culture & Trends
- [Meta Newsroom](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_meta_newsroom.xml): Meta news, engineering, and AI blogs plus Meta developer changelogs and blogs -- in one feed.
- [Sony](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_sony.xml): Combined Sony feed: Sony Group press, Sony Electronics, SIE press releases, PlayStation Blog, Sony Music PL (+ newsroom), and Sony PL community wallpapers.
- [Samsung Newsroom](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_samsung.xml): Combined Samsung feed: Newsroom global and PL, Mobile Press, Samsung Developers, Samsung NEXT, SmartThings, and the Polish Samsung Community board.
- [Apple](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_apple.xml): Combined Apple feed: Newsroom PL, Developer news and releases, Technotes, iOS/iPadOS, macOS and Safari release notes, and Developer Account release notes.
- [HP Newsroom](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_hp.xml): Combined HP feed: HP Support bulletins and HPE Newsroom.
- [Lenovo](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_lenovo.xml): Combined Lenovo feed: StoryHub newsroom, lenovo24.pl, Lenovo Gaming PL, and the CDRT blog.
- [Xiaomi Newsroom](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_xiaomi.xml): Combined Xiaomi feed: xiaomi.eu community, Xiaomi Advices, Xiaomi Today, and Xiaomi Corp investor news.
- [Palantir](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_palantir.xml): Palantir newsroom, blog, media coverage, press releases, Foundry announcements, and release notes.
- [Nexus Mods News](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_nexusmods_news.xml): Site news, competitions, and interviews from Nexus Mods
- [Bethesda News](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_bethesda.xml): Combined Bethesda feed: Bethesda.net News (PL), The Elder Scrolls News (PL), and Fallout News (PL).
- [Electronic Arts](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_ea.xml): Combined EA feed: EA News (PL), EA Research & Technology, EA Sports News (PL), SEED, and EA Sports FC 26 News (PL).
- [Steam](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_steam.xml): Combined Steam news feed: the global Steam news feed plus selected games and groups, from Steam's native news RSS.
- [Bank Pekao SA](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_pekao.xml): Aktualnosci, informacje prasowe i Peoview Banku Pekao SA. Zrodla: pekao.com.pl i media.pekao.com.pl.
- [Canva](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_canva.xml): Canva newsroom announcements and Learn design guides, aggregated via Google News
- [NASA](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_nasa.xml): Combined NASA feed: the main newsroom, the blogs firehose, NASA Science, the launch schedule, the Image of the Day, and Astronomy Picture of the Day.
- [ESA](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/feed_esa.xml): Combined European Space Agency feed: Newsroom, Corporate News, the per-activity feeds (Space News, Space Science, Operations, Observing the Earth, Launchers, Navigation, Telecommunications), the Week in Images, the Webb and Hubble imagery feeds, and the active blogs.esa.int mission blogs.
